# Golden fixtures — synthetic original-format scenarios

License-clean, hand-verified scenario bytes for the original Westwood format.
**No retail game data is included.** Every byte is generated by
`tools/gen_fixtures.py` from the constants in that script; the real-data path
in the tests is opt-in through `CNC_ORIGINAL_DATA_DIR` and skips otherwise.

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| `td/FIXTURE.INI` | Original-dialect TD scenario: `[Basic]`, `[Objectives]`, `[Houses]`, `[Wunits]`, `[Structures]`, `[Trigs]`, `[TRIGGER]`, `[Waypoints]`, `[Map]`. |
| `td/FIXTURE.bin` | Matching 16×16 map image, **LCW-compressed** (format80) so `load_scenario` exercises the compressed decode path. |
| `td/FIXTURE_RAW.bin` | The same 16×16 image as the retail on-disk layout: 512 bytes, two bytes per cell (`TemplateType`, `TIcon`). |
| `ra/FIXTURE.MPR` | Original-format RA scenario with `[Basic]`, `[MapPack]`, `[OverlayPack]`, `[Houses]`, `[Units]`, `[Infantry]`, `[Structures]`, `[Waypoints]`, `[Trigs]`. |
| `CHECKSUMS.sha256` | SHA-256 of every committed fixture file (paths relative to this directory). |

## Encoding

* **TD `.bin`**: decoded payload is one `(TemplateType, TIcon)` pair per
  cell, row-major (`TIBERIANDAWN/MAP.CPP` `Read_Binary`). `FIXTURE.BIN` is
  the same payload run through the format80 encoder, which the Rust loader also
  accepts (`decode_bin` falls back to LCW when the file is not a raw square
  grid). The extension is lowercase because `bin_path_for` derives the sibling
  name with `Path::with_extension("bin")`.
* **RA `MapPack` / `OverlayPack`**: numbered INI lines whose values are
  RFC 4648 base64, decoded in numeric key order and concatenated
  (`REDALERT/INI.CPP` `Get_UUBlock`). The decoded bytes of this synthetic
  fixture are a **format80 (LCW)** stream, so the fixture exercises the LCW
  codec named by the plan. Decompressing yields 3-byte records
  `(u16 LE cell index, u8 id)` (`cnc_asset::ra_pack`).

## Expected contents (hand-checked)

TD map, 16×16 = 256 cells:

* diagonal (`x == y`): template `12`, 16 cells;
* outer ring (non-diagonal border cells): template `5`, 58 cells;
* interior: template `7`, 182 cells;
* icon byte = `(x * 3 + y) % 8`.
* Entities: 3 units (E1/GDI, MTNK/GDI, BGGY/Nod), 2 structures (FACT/GDI,
  OBLI/Nod), 2 `[Trigs]` triggers, 2 `[TRIGGER]` records, 3 waypoints,
  2 houses.

RA map, 16×16 = 256 packed cells:

* diagonal: id `11`, 16 cells;
* the two non-diagonal corners: id `22`, 2 cells;
* everything else: id `0`, 238 cells.
* Overlay: id `3` (road) at cells 0 and 255.
* Entities: 2 houses, 2 units, 1 infantry, 2 structures, 3 waypoints,
  2 `[Trigs]` triggers.

## Regenerating and verifying

```sh
python3 RUST/fixtures/tools/gen_fixtures.py
cd RUST/fixtures && sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256
cargo test -p cnc-tiberian-dawn fixture
```

The test suite (`RUST/cnc-tiberian-dawn/tests/original_fixtures.rs`) decodes the
payloads with `cnc_asset::format80` + `cnc_asset::ra_pack` and checks them
against the hand-written inventory above; the fixture bytes are never trusted
just because this script wrote them.
